title: A Streaming Helper That Keeps the Counts
description: A streaming Ollama helper that reads each chunk, prints the text as it arrives, and keeps the final chunk where the token counts live.

steps.description: The imports and the function definition. `OLLAMA_URL` and `MODEL` come from `token_usage`. The docstring states the key fact: with streaming, the counts arrive only in the last chunk, the one with `done=true`.
The request posts to `OLLAMA_URL` with `"stream": True` and the temperature in `options`, and reads the response as a stream.
The loop reads the response line by line, parses each chunk, prints its content piece as it arrives, and appends the piece to `text`.
When a chunk has `done` true, the code keeps it in `final`. The comment says `prompt_eval_count` and `eval_count` live in that chunk.
After the loop, if a final chunk was kept, the full text is attached to it as the message, and the chunk is returned so the counts are not thrown away.
